observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor powwow arena at night, illuminated by spotlights, with spectators gathered in the background.
observation.formation_and_space: Soloist dancing stationary or moving back and forth within a spotlighted area of the arena
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward lean, knees bent and lifting with each step, bearing weight dynamically on alternating feet
observation.footwork: Bouncing stepping pattern on the balls of the feet synchronized with drumbeats, lifting feet off the ground between steps
observation.arms_and_hands: Left hand on hip, right hand holding and occasionally waving a feathered fan or raising overhead
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso movement, maintaining an upright posture while the lower body bounces and steps
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to medium level bouncing steps, occasional light hops and pivots
observation.costume_and_props: Dark, patterned jingle dress adorned with metal cones, tall white feathered hair ornament, light-colored tall boots, holding a feathered fan
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and subtle weight shifts are obscured by dark lighting and video compression.

signature_moments.what: Bouncing and stepping in place with the right hand holding the fan steady at the hip while the jingles ring on each beat.
Lifting knees higher and raising the feathered fan while stepping rhythmically to the accelerating drum beat.
Extending the right arm outward while maintaining rapid stepping footwork.
Raising the feathered fan high overhead while turning slightly and continuing the bounce.
Spotlighted solo footwork with continuous knee lifts and jingle dress sound accompaniment.
